# Chat flood control and chat masks from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/chat.c
# (compiled unmodified; see the driver for the one substitution, a
# harness-driven clock in place of time(), which is what makes the expiry
# times in this file plain numbers of seconds rather than wall-clock values).
#
#   # <label>   starts a scenario; 'settings' gives the globals chat.c read
#   seat <n>    seated n players and ran PA_PREENTERARENA on each
#   at ticks=<n> wall=<n>   set the tick clock and the second clock
#   flood <player> x<n>     ran expire_mask then check_flood, n times
#   expire <player>         ran expire_mask alone
#   canspam <0|1>           what capman now answers for CAP_CANSPAM
#   preenter <player>       ran the PA_PREENTERARENA player action
#   setmask <player> <mask> timeout=<n>   called Ichat::SetPlayerChatMask
#   getmask <player> -> <mask>            called Ichat::GetPlayerChatMask
#   msg <text>  each chat line the module sent
#   state <player>:<mask>/<seconds until expiry>/<msgs>/<lastcheck>... arena:<mask>
#      an expiry of 0 means no expiry -- a session-long mask, or none at all
#
# Rules these records pin:
#
# 1. THE MESSAGE COUNTER DECAYS BY A RIGHT SHIFT, not by subtraction: on every
#    check it computes d = (now - lastcheck) / 100, i.e. whole seconds, and does
#    msgs >>= d. So the count halves once per second of silence, and a burst
#    inside one second decays not at all. lastcheck moves to now every time,
#    even when d is zero, so a player checked twice within a second never decays.
# 2. THE SHUTUP TEST IS msgs >= FloodLimit AFTER the increment, so a limit of N
#    trips on the Nth message in a window, not the N+1th. A FloodLimit of 0 or
#    less disables flood control entirely, and the counter still runs.
# 3. ON TRIPPING, THE COUNTER IS HALVED rather than cleared, so a player who keeps
#    talking trips again almost immediately -- every second message, once the
#    count is at the limit. Each trip extends the shutup.
# 4. HOW THE EXPIRY IS SET DEPENDS ON WHAT WAS THERE. If the player already has an
#    expiry it is EXTENDED by FloodShutup. If there is no expiry and no mask, a
#    fresh one is set to now + FloodShutup. But if there is a mask with NO expiry
#    -- a session-long mask set by a moderator -- neither branch runs, so the
#    flood bits are OR'd in and NEVER EXPIRE. That player is silenced until they
#    leave the arena, and no record anywhere says why. Driven below.
# 5. THE FLOOD MASK IS NINE SPECIFIC BITS, OR'd into whatever is already there:
#    pubmacro, pub, freq, nmefreq, priv, remotepriv, chat, modchat and bcommand.
#    Notably it does NOT include the command types, so a shut-up player can still
#    use commands.
# 6. CAP_CANSPAM SKIPS THE WHOLE CHECK, but only after the counter has already
#    been incremented -- so a staff member's count still climbs, and if the
#    capability is ever lost the accumulated count applies immediately.
# 7. SetPlayerChatMask with timeout 0 is a SESSION-LONG mask (expires 0); any
#    other timeout sets expires to now + timeout. expire_mask clears the mask
#    entirely once the wall clock passes it -- and the test is strictly greater,
#    so the mask survives the second it expires on.
# 8. PA_PREENTERARENA clears the mask, the expiry AND the counter, and resets
#    lastcheck to now -- so changing arena resets a flood shutup.
# 9. Chat:RestrictChat is read at AA_CREATE and AA_CONFCHANGED into a per-arena
#    mask that is separate from the per-player one.
#
# UNDEFINED BEHAVIOUR, DOCUMENTED AND NOT DRIVEN. The decay is 'msgs >>= d' with d
# a whole number of seconds and msgs an int, so a player silent for 32 seconds or
# more shifts by at least the width of the type, which C leaves undefined. On x86
# the shift count is taken mod 32, which means a silence of exactly 32 seconds
# decays the count by NOTHING at all while 31 seconds clears it. No record here
# goes past d = 31; a port should clamp the shift, which is a deliberate
# divergence worth writing down rather than an accident.
floodbits 16be
# FloodLimit 5: the fifth message in a window trips it
settings floodlimit=5 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 2
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x4
state 0:0000/0/4/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x1
state 0:16be/60/2/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x1
state 0:16be/60/3/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x1
state 0:16be/60/4/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x1
state 0:16be/120/2/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
# the counter halves once per second of silence
settings floodlimit=5 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x4
state 0:0000/0/4/1000 arena:0000
at ticks=1050 wall=500
expire 0
state 0:0000/0/4/1050 arena:0000
at ticks=1100 wall=501
expire 0
state 0:0000/0/4/1100 arena:0000
at ticks=1300 wall=503
expire 0
state 0:0000/0/1/1300 arena:0000
at ticks=1400 wall=504
expire 0
state 0:0000/0/0/1400 arena:0000
# a burst inside one second does not decay at all
settings floodlimit=10 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x9
state 0:0000/0/9/1000 arena:0000
at ticks=1099 wall=500
flood 0 x1
state 0:16be/60/5/1099 arena:0000
# FloodLimit 0 disables the check but the counter still runs
settings floodlimit=0 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x20
state 0:0000/0/20/1000 arena:0000
# CAP_CANSPAM skips the check, but the counter still climbs
settings floodlimit=5 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=1 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x20
state 0:0000/0/20/1000 arena:0000
# the capability is withdrawn: the accumulated count trips at once
canspam 0
flood 0 x1
state 0:16be/60/10/1000 arena:0000
# a session-long mask plus a flood: the shutup NEVER expires
settings floodlimit=3 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
setmask 0 0004 timeout=0
state 0:0004/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x3
state 0:16be/0/1/1000 arena:0000
# expiry is still 0, so no amount of waiting clears these bits.
# the tick clock moves only 30 seconds here while the wall clock moves
# 99500: a tick gap of 32 seconds or more would make the decay shift
# undefined, and no record in this file goes there.
at ticks=4000 wall=100000
expire 0
state 0:16be/0/0/4000 arena:0000
# the same flood with no prior mask does get an expiry
settings floodlimit=3 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x3
state 0:16be/60/1/1000 arena:0000
at ticks=1000 wall=559
expire 0
state 0:16be/1/1/1000 arena:0000
at ticks=1000 wall=560
expire 0
state 0:16be/0/1/1000 arena:0000
at ticks=1000 wall=561
expire 0
state 0:0000/0/1/1000 arena:0000
# SetPlayerChatMask, with and without a timeout
settings floodlimit=10 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 2
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
setmask 0 000f timeout=30
state 0:000f/30/0/1000 1:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
getmask 0 -> 000f
setmask 1 00f0 timeout=0
state 0:000f/30/0/1000 1:00f0/0/0/1000 arena:0000
getmask 1 -> 00f0
at ticks=1000 wall=529
expire 0
state 0:000f/1/0/1000 1:00f0/0/0/1000 arena:0000
at ticks=1000 wall=531
expire 0
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 1:00f0/0/0/1000 arena:0000
getmask 1 -> 00f0
# PA_PREENTERARENA clears a flood shutup
settings floodlimit=3 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=0 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
flood 0 x3
state 0:16be/60/1/1000 arena:0000
# re-entering an arena resets mask, expiry and counter
preenter 0
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0000
# Chat:RestrictChat sets a separate per-arena mask
settings floodlimit=10 floodshutup=60 restrictchat=6 canspam=0 ticks=1000 wall=500
seat 1
state 0:0000/0/0/1000 arena:0006
# the arena mask is independent of the player's
setmask 0 0100 timeout=0
state 0:0100/0/0/1000 arena:0006
